mapper.sql: id, username, password_hash, display_name, email, phone_country_code, phone, vip_level, credit_score, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM vip_user
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM vip_user WHERE username = #{username} AND status = 'ENABLED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vip_user WHERE LOWER(TRIM(email)) = LOWER(TRIM(#{email})) AND username != #{username}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vip_user WHERE COALESCE(phone_country_code, '+86') = COALESCE(#{phoneCountryCode}, '+86') AND REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(phone), ' ', ''), '-', ''), '(', ''), ')', '') = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(#{phone}), ' ', ''), '-', ''), '(', ''), ')', '') AND username != #{username}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vip_user WHERE LOWER(TRIM(email)) = LOWER(TRIM(#{email}))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vip_user WHERE LOWER(TRIM(email)) = LOWER(TRIM(#{email})) AND id != #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vip_user (username, password_hash, display_name, email, phone_country_code, phone, vip_level, credit_score, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{email}, #{phoneCountryCode}, #{phone}, #{vipLevel}, #{creditScore}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE vip_user SET username = #{username}, password_hash = #{passwordHash}, display_name = #{displayName}, email = #{email}, phone_country_code = #{phoneCountryCode}, phone = #{phone}, vip_level = #{vipLevel}, credit_score = #{creditScore}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
